messages:
Eli H: morning team, Eli here (first day in CS) :wave: quick checklist request — what do I need access to out of the gate? HubSpot, Aircall, playbooks, scripts, and any CS-specific templates. who should I tag to get things moving?
Katie O: welcome Eli!! :tada: short answer: @Mike (IT) for HubSpot/Aircall, @Liz C for playbooks and routing, @Jamie R for objection/script review.
Mike (IT): Hi Eli — opened a HubSpot invite and a pending Aircall seat request. Watch for invites from hubspot-invite@redwood and aircall@notifications. If Aircall doesn't arrive within 2 hours I can escalate to the reseller.
Eli H: thanks Mike — will check spam and let you know. are there any default access scopes I should expect in HubSpot?
Liz C: HubSpot: CS role gets contacts, tickets, playbook snippets, and the 'cs-playbooks' folder link. No permission to change billing. Aircall: full dialer, call recordings view, and voicemail-to-ticket.
Jamie R: Eli - for onboarding let's book a 30-min playbook runthrough. I also have a lightweight 1-pager "First Week CS Cadence" I'll share.
Onboarding Bot: Hi Eli — Friendly reminder: complete "Sales/CS Tools" checklist in the onboarding portal within 48 hours to avoid seat deprovisioning. https://onboard.redwood/checklists/sales-cs
Eli H: got the hubspot invite and set MFA. Aircall still pending. also can't find the objection cheat-sheet in drive (search "OBJECTION MAP" returned nothing).
Jamie R: The file is "OBJECTION_MAP_v2 - CS" under "/playbooks/cs/cheatsheets". DMing the direct link now.
Liz C: Note on call recordings: recordings are enabled by default for training and QA. If you're handling sensitive customer data ask for rec-off via compliance channel. Voicemails route to the CS ticket queue (priority: low, then triage).
Katie O: one more: use the "cs-templates" Aircall script when doing outbound check-ins, it auto-populates the HubSpot activity. I'll add you to the Notion templates page.
Mike (IT): Eli — Aircall invite resent. You'll get a one-time setup link. If link errors, reply with the device you're on (Mac/Win/iOS/Android).
Eli H: received Aircall! joined and set up headset. thanks everyone :raised_hands: Any recommended first-day listening sessions?
Jamie R: listen to two recent CS calls in the "call-library" folder. I'll flag 2 examples — one onboarding call and one escalation call.
Katie O: welcome aboard again — we'll pair you with a buddy for week 1. Ping me if you need immediate handoff template. :rocket:
